globalParameters.label: Routing
globalParameters.description: Routing topology. Changes apply to newly started notes; existing notes retain their routing.

globalParameters.label: Output
globalParameters.description: Master output amplitude, smoothed over approximately 10 ms, before the output saturator.

globalParameters.label: Feedback
globalParameters.description: Operator 6 self phase modulation, delayed by one internal sample at 4x sample rate.

operatorParameters.label: Ratio
operatorParameters.description: Oscillator frequency divided by the played note frequency. Integer ratios tend toward harmonic spectra.

operatorParameters.label: Detune
operatorParameters.description: Pitch offset in cents, applied after the frequency ratio.

operatorParameters.label: Level
operatorParameters.description: Envelope-scaled amplitude. As a modulator, full level corresponds to 8 radians of phase modulation; as a carrier, it changes audible level.

operatorParameters.label: Attack
operatorParameters.description: Linear rise to maximum envelope level. Duration is captured at note-on.

operatorParameters.label: Decay
operatorParameters.description: Linear fall from peak to sustain. Duration is captured after the attack and any hold stage.

operatorParameters.label: Sustain
operatorParameters.description: Envelope level while a key is held after decay.

operatorParameters.label: Release
operatorParameters.description: Linear fall from the current envelope level to silence after note-off. Duration is captured at note-off.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Pitch depth
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Pitch envelope depth in semitones. Zero disables pitch movement. Captured at note-on.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Pitch delay
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Time before the pitch envelope starts. Captured at note-on.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Pitch attack
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Rise from the played pitch to the pitch depth.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Pitch hold
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Time at full pitch depth before decay.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Pitch decay
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Move from full pitch depth to the sustain proportion.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Pitch sustain
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Proportion of pitch depth held after decay.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Pitch release
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Return to the played pitch after note-off.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Filter
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Resonant output filter mode, before the output saturator.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Cutoff
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Filter cutoff, smoothed over approximately 10 ms and limited by the sample rate.

extensionGlobalParameters.label: Resonance
extensionGlobalParameters.description: Resonance Q. Larger values emphasize frequencies near cutoff.

extensionOperatorParameters.label: Wave
extensionOperatorParameters.description: Oscillator shape, captured at note-on. Noise is deterministic white noise; ratio and incoming phase modulation do not change a noise source.

extensionOperatorParameters.label: Delay
extensionOperatorParameters.description: Silence before attack. Captured at note-on.

extensionOperatorParameters.label: Hold
extensionOperatorParameters.description: Time at maximum envelope level between attack and decay. Captured at note-on.
